title: Cloud City: Cheat Sheet: Cloud Load Balancing Selection Matrix
city_concept: City Canal Locks & Harbor Piloting Stations

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Boats of all sizes were crowding into narrow canals simultaneously, causing collisions between rowboats and cargo barges.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Harbor Master Hugh built piloting stations: Outer Gates for ocean ships (Global ALB) and Canal Sluices for internal barges (Internal LB).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Pilots inspected cargo manifests (Layer 7 inspection), directing grain ships to northern docks and passenger boats to downtown piers.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Canal locks operate with physical water valves; cloud load balancers balance gigabits of network traffic via Maglev software SDN.
